title.narrative: Public Relations Project for Promoting Gender Equality among Hight School Youth in Bangkok, Thailand

description.narrative: Currently, the situation of gender equality in Thai society has been improving. However, challenges related to gender-based practices and sexual violence persist. Rapid dissemination of information through technological advancements exacerbates these issues. Media also significantly influences shaping thoughts and beliefs, potentially leading to biased expressions of gender-related behaviors/sexual practices, particularly cyberbullying. According to the Department of Mental Health, Thailand ranked second globally in cyberbullying in 2020, following Japan. Survey results indicate that over 91% of youth have experienced cyberbullying, with 43% considering retaliation, posing an increased risk of escalating issues. Our project team has prior experience receiving funding from the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security, Thailand, to conduct activities promoting gender equality in 2023. To address and prevent future issues, it is essential to raise awareness and understanding of non-gender-based practices and promote gender equality among the youth in Bangkok. This includes respecting others' rights, knowing how to address problems, protecting mental and physical well-being, and being able to adapt and live happily in a collaborative society.
